2317-5147-7084-8345.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat.

176-4875-5231.easyPrerequisites:
Conspiracy has any type chosen that isn't "Spirit".
You control another creature.
176-4875-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token. The token won't be a Soldier due to Conspiracy.
Repeat.

2390-3966-8173.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-3966-8173.description:
Gain life.
Lyra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each Angel you control
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

529-5641-6965-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

7690-8166-8181--165.description:
Cast Proctor of Potential by paying {W}{U}.
When Proctor of Potential enters, it triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the token enters, Proctor of Potential triggers, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2301-2464-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2301-2464-3249--52.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
728-2301-2464-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Abzan Ascendancy triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

855-2021-2060-2265.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

1661-5078-7693.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
1661-5078-7693.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-6972-7606.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Rampant Rejuvenator.
When Rampant Rejuvenator dies, it's innate ability and persist ability each trigger.
Resolve the trigger from Rampant Rejuvenator's innate ability, allowing you to search your library for a number of basic land cards and put them onto the battlefield.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Rampant Rejuvenator from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

240-2921-4452.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Rukarumel, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-2921-4452.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

3490-4659-5870-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4659-5870-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1417-5147-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
1417-5147-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Bridge from Below and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

880-3875-7201.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Tireless Provisioner and Sapling Nursery trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Sapling Nursery trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

575-1912-5971-7097.notablePrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-1912-5971-7097.description:
Activate Yavimaya Elder by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
When Yavimaya Elder dies, it and Yedora trigger.
Resolve the Yavimaya Elder trigger, allowing you to search your library for up to two basic land cards and put them into your hand.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning Yavimaya Elder from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Yavimaya Elder enters, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yavimaya Elder by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Yavimaya Elder face-up.
Resolve the Yavimaya Elder ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

339-647-677-3967.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

632-2034-3621-5129-5295.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-2034-3621-5129-5295.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

3129-4484-4871-6518.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
3129-4484-4871-6518.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
When Ebondeath enters, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Ebondeath and creating two 2/2 Zombie Druid creature tokens.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

509-1267-4883-5056.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each extra turn
509-1267-4883-5056.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-4883-5056.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Neurok Transmuter by paying {U}, causing Medomai the Ageless to become an artifact.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Activate Contagion Clasp by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 6.

997-2382-5659--33.notablePrerequisites: One Lhurgoyf must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mimic Vat.
997-2382-5659--33.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a nontoken Lhurgoyf.
When the Lhurgoyf dies, Mimic Vat triggers, exiling the Lhurgoyf from your graveyard and returning the Lhurgoyf that was exiled to your graveyard.
Disa's first ability triggers, putting the Lhurgoyf from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

997-4871-5544-6011.notablePrerequisites: Scavenger's Talent is at least level 2.
997-4871-5544-6011.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Scavenger's Talent's second ability triggers, targeting an opponent, and Pitiless Plunderer triggers.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Scavenger's Talent trigger, causing an opponent to mill two cards.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2082-2292-3197.easyPrerequisites: Sadistic Glee attached to Herd Baloth.
2082-2292-3197.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2082-2292-3197.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies, Sadisitc Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

784-1750-2793-2829-5261.notablePrerequisites: Silas Renn cannot be blocked by an opponent.
784-1750-2793-2829-5261.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Silas Renn, triggering Silas Renn, targeting Ugin's Nexus.
Cast Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Repeat.

573-751-3314-3875.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Tireless Provisioner.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1187-2114-3258.notablePrerequisites:
Ayara's Oathsworn does not have summoning sickness and has exactly three +1/+1 counters on it.
An opponent cannot block Ayara's Oathsworn.
1187-2114-3258.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Ayara's Oathsworn.
Ayara's Oathsworn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and putting it into your hand.
Activate Ion Storm by paying {1}{R} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Ayara's Oathsworn, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one, and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Repeat each turn.

1399-1513-2681-3814.notablePrerequisites: Argothian Elder does not have summoning sickness.
1399-1513-2681-3814.description:
Activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding {G}.
Forbidden Orchard triggers, causing an opponent to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Argothian Elder.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping Forbidden Orchard and Wirewood Lodge.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding {B}.
Forbidden Orchard triggers, causing an opponent to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Cast Deadly Tempest by paying {4}{B}{B}, destroying all creatures and causing each player to lose life equal to the number of creatures they had destroyed this way.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

210-220-2500-5195.description:
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Storm-Kiln Artist until end of turn.
Cast Chain Lightning by paying {R}, targeting Brash Taunter.
Storm-Kiln Artist and Mirage Mirror each trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Resolve Chain Lightning, dealing 3 damage to Brash Taunter, and causing you to pay {R}{R} to copy Chain Lightning, targeting Brash Taunter.
Brash Taunter, Storm-Kiln Artist, and Mirage Mirror each trigger.
Resolve the Brash Taunter trigger, dealing 3 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist and Mirage Mirror triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 4.

1247-2033-3430.notablePrerequisites: Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
1247-2033-3430.description:
Activate Pili-Pala using Paradise Mantle's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Pili-Pala's other ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding three mana of any one color.
Repeat.

331-3011-4591.easyPrerequisites: Heartless Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
331-3011-4591.description:
Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, causing it to deal lethal damage to each player with an even life total and nearly lethal damage to each player with an odd life total.
You cannot lose the game due to Platinum Angel.

Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Conspiracy, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
